title: Reasoning Chain
description: Schema for a single architectural reasoning chain entry. AI agents read this before coding and write new entries after completing complex features or bug fixes.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this chain was authored

tags.description: Lowercase tags for filtering: chunker, retriever, health_check, etc.

status.description: active = currently applicable; deprecated = no longer relevant; superseded = replaced by a newer chain

superseded_by.description: chain_id of the newer chain that replaces this one (required when status=superseded)

related_chains.description: List of related chain_ids for cross-referencing

context.description: Background: what problem triggered this decision, what constraints existed

alternatives.description: Alternatives considered before the final decision (2-4 typical)

rationale.description: Why this option won: architectural alignment, risk profile, simplicity, etc.

evidence.description: Concrete artifacts that validate this decision

future_guidance.description: Rules for future AI agents: what patterns to follow, what anti-patterns to avoid

anti_patterns.description: Explicit list of things future code must NOT do, based on this experience
